'''Rie Tanaka''' (Japanese: '''田中理恵 ''' ''Tanaka Rie'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Tanaka was born on January 3, 1979 in {{wp|Sapporo}}, {{wp|Hokkaidō}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She provided her voice for {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|RS}} and {{aniseries|DP}}, voicing [[Pokémon Coordinator]] [[Solidad]] and [[Team Galactic]] {{tc|Commander}} [[Mars]], respectively. Tanaka was once married to voice actor [[Kōichi Yamadera]], but the two divorced on August 4, 2018.
